voice: a forwarded email thread the assistant has access to, with the assistant's own short summary note on top
format: email headers (From/To/Date/Subject) and quoted replies with '>' markers; profile, rules and preferences appear inside the emails or in the assistant's note; the pending item is in the most recent email
verbosity: verbose; polite email prose with greetings and sign-offs
notes: Dates in email headers use RFC-2822 style like 'Tue, 5 Mar 2024 09:12'. Keep dated updates with their dates.
